# Tapatalk

> > Tapatalk provides mobile-first forum hosting through Tapatalk Groups and a mobile app connecting 200,000+ forums, with managed cloud hosting on AWS/Azure infrastructure.

Tapatalk (operated by Everforo, Inc and Quoord Systems Limited) offers two main products: Tapatalk Groups for creating free cloud-hosted forums with SEO optimization and spam protection, and the Tapatalk Mobile App for iOS/Android that aggregates access to hundreds of thousands of existing forums. The platform emphasizes mobile-first community building with features like custom domains, advertisement control, and the Site Owner Console.

## Key Topics

- Tapatalk Groups
- Tapatalk Mobile App
- Mobile-first community platform
- Free forum hosting
- Cloud-hosted forums (AWS, Azure, IBM SoftLayer)
- Forum migration
- SEO optimization (Google SEO, Google AMP)
- Spam protection
- Custom domain support
- Tapatalk VIP
- Site Owner Console
- Forum aggregator
- Community building
- iOS and Android apps
- Tapatalk Plug-In

- [Tapatalk - 200,000+ Forums App - App Store](https://tapatalk.com/m): App Store listing for Tapatalk mobile app connecting 200,000+ forums
